name: print-social-modern-gym-posts-dark-blue-neon-arrows-dedication
title: 'Modern Gym — Dedication, Determination' pack in dark blue with neon orange-green arrow accents
whatItIs: Nine dark navy-to-blue square posts with neon orange and green arrow and squiggle shapes, wavy line textures, black-and-white gym photos, bold headlines ('Dedication, Determination', 'Transform Your Body, Transform Your Life', 'Hustle for that Muscles'), and a small 'Modern Gym' pixel-cross logo.
whatItMeans: Energetic and driven; neon directional arrows give a gym pack forward momentum that matches its motivational copy.
techniques: Use neon arrow shapes to suggest direction and progress.
Add wavy line textures behind greyscale photos for movement.
Keep a consistent small pixel-style logo across every post.

vocabulary.definition: An arrow shape used decoratively to suggest motion or progress.
A logo built from blocky, pixel-like segments.
